dataQuality.representativeMetrics: 2026.01-07 use the canonical dedup row stored in competitor_809440.db; child rows are never summed
dataQuality.ranking: 2026.01-07 category tiers use the best parsable 小类BSR among qualifying variants in the same parent family
dataQuality.top100Cap: each category/month is deterministically capped at 100 listings; all tier tables reuse that exact Top100 pool

definitions.pp: 标题按不区分大小写的完整单词 plastic（单词边界）筛选；2026父体任一变体命中即归PP，空标题按空字符串
definitions.high: 排除 PP 父体后的全部商品（SPEC 7.5：其余全部归入高客单非PP，不再叠加材质关键词或价格门槛）
definitions.bsrTop100: minimum numeric 小类BSR among qualifying variants in the same listing family; deterministic cap at 100; bands 1-5, 6-10, 11-20, 21-50, 51-100
definitions.bsrGroups: head = 1-20, middle = 21-50, tail = 51-100; groups do not overlap
definitions.avgListPrice: simple average of SKU list prices
definitions.momMonthly: 月度MOM（用户口径）：今年X月 vs 去年X月同月（跨年同月）
definitions.chainMonthly: 月度环比：本月 vs 上月（连续月环比）
definitions.annualYoY: 年度同周期对比（今年 vs 去年同月份集合；2026 核心比较为 2026.01-06 vs 2025.01-06）
